applies_why: The judge text addresses whether Matthew 1:20 counts for the challenger and states that it was answered in [CR3] LINK 2.
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
room: must not count it — either the judge still treated Matthew 1:20 as an unanswered broken-link witness despite saying it was answered, or the judge treated the answer as excluding it from the count; I read the text as the latter because it says answered and does not assign it to a broken link.
why: The judge text says Matthew 1:20 was answered in [CR3] LINK 2 and does not count it toward a broken link, which is exactly what K-G4 permits.
